title: Alex's Caves/Origins fix
description: Fixes a compatibility issue between Alex's Caves and Origins mods. Fixes a bug where the game would crash when approaching Gumworm.
body:
## Fixes a compatibility issue between Alex's Caves and Origins mods.

Fixes a bug where the game would crash when approaching Gumworm.

Works with Origins via the Synitra Connector and forge Alex's Caves.

Tested with:

- Origins 1.10.2
- Alex's Caves 2.0.2
- Sinytra Connector beta 48+

Have a good time and good modpacks (o゜▽゜)o☆
